title: Agent Bundle Format (ABF) v0.3 credential requirements
description: Which credentials an ABF v0.3 bundle needs, resolved against the importer's own accounts. Secret values are never in a bundle. BETA. See https://docs.agentmux.ai/abf.

id.description: Stable identifier for this requirement within the bundle.

credentialProvider.description: The service the credential is for, e.g. 'github', 'anthropic', 'aws'. Called 'provider' in v0.1.

env.description: Environment variable the resolved credential is injected as at launch, e.g. 'GITHUB_TOKEN'.
